title: NEET UG 2027 Eligibility: Age Limit, Number of Attempts, Subjects and Open-School Rules
seoTitle: NEET Eligibility 2027: Age, Attempts, Subjects, NIOS
seoDescription: NEET eligibility 2027: 17 by 31 Dec 2027, no upper age or attempt limit, PCB/Biotech with English, and NIOS, private, NRI and OCI candidates can apply.
excerpt: Why there is no NEET attempt limit (yet), what the NMC's 2023 rules and the latest NTA bulletin actually say, and a table for NIOS, private, repeater, NRI, OCI and study-abroad candidates.
